1.english_reference: And because of all this we make a sure [ covenant ] , and write [ it ]

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל זֹ֕את אֲנַ֛חְנוּ כֹּרְתִ֥ים אֲמָנָ֖ה וְ כֹתְבִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Super ómnibus ergo his nos ipsi percútimus fœdus , et scríbimus ,
traditions.KJV: And because of all this we make a sure [ covenant ] , and write [ it ] ;

1.english_reference: and our princes , Levites , [ and ] priests , seal [ unto it ]

traditions.WLC: וְ עַל֙ הֶֽ חָת֔וּם שָׂרֵ֥י נוּ לְוִיֵּ֖ נוּ כֹּהֲנֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν σφραγιζόντων Νεεμίας υἱὸς Ἁχελιά καὶ Σεδεκίας
traditions.VUL: et signant príncipes nostri , Levítæ nostri , et sacerdótes nostri .
traditions.KJV: and our princes , Levites , [ and ] priests , seal [ unto it ] .

2.english_reference: Nehemiah , the Tirshatha , the son of Hachaliah , and Zidkijah

traditions.WLC: נְחֶמְיָ֧ה הַ תִּרְשָׁ֛תָא בֶּן חֲכַלְיָ֖ה וְ צִדְקִיָּֽה
traditions.LXX: υἱὸς Σαραιά καὶ Ἀζαριά καὶ Ἰερμιά
traditions.VUL: Nehemías , Athérsatha fílius Hachélai , et Sedecías ,
traditions.KJV: Nehemiah , the Tirshatha , the son of Hachaliah , and Zidkijah ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται , Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Ἀζανειά , Βαναιοὺ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἡναδάβ , Καδμιὴλ

10.english_reference: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah ,

traditions.KJV: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah ,

10.english_reference: Binnui of the sons of Henadad ,

traditions.KJV: Binnui of the sons of Henadad ,

traditions.LXX: ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ Φόρος , Φααδμωάβ , Ἠλάμ , Ζαθουιά · υἱοὶ Βανί ,

traditions.WLC: פַּרְעֹשׁ֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עֵילָ֥ם זַתּ֖וּא בָּנִֽי

traditions.LXX: Καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ , οἱ ἱερεῖς , οἱ Λευεῖται , οἱ πυλωροί , οἱ ᾄδοντες , οἱ Ναθινείμ , καὶ πᾶς ὁ προσπορευόμενος ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς πρὸς νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ , γυναῖκες αὐτῶν , υἱοὶ αὐτῶν , θυγατέρες αὐτῶν · πᾶς ὁ εἰδὼς καὶ συνίων

29.english_reference: And the rest of the people ,

traditions.KJV: And the rest of the people ,

29.english_reference: and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God ,

traditions.WLC: וְֽ כָל הַ נִּבְדָּ֞ל מֵ עַמֵּ֤י הָ אֲרָצוֹת֙ אֶל תּוֹרַ֣ת הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: ἐνίσχυον ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν , κατηράσαντο αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰσήλθοσαν ἐν ἀρᾷ καὶ ἐν ὅρκῳ Τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐν νόμῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ὃς ἐδόθη ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ δούλου τοῦ θεοῦ , καὶ φυλάσσεσθαι καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς ἡμῶν καὶ κρίματα αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et omnes qui se separavérunt de pópulis terrárum ad legem Dei ,
traditions.KJV: and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God ,

traditions.VUL: omnes qui póterant sápere spondéntes pro frátribus suis ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῦ μὴ δοῦναι θυγατέρας ἡμῶν τοῖς λαοῖς τῆς γῆς , καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν οὐ λημψόμεθα τοῖς υἱοῖς ἡμῶν ·

traditions.WLC: לָ לֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּ תוֹרַ֣ת הָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים

30.english_reference: which was given by Moses the servant of God ,

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִתְּנָ֔ה בְּ יַ֖ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: quam déderat in manu Móysi servi Dei ,
traditions.KJV: which was given by Moses the servant of God ,

30.english_reference: and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לִ שְׁמ֣וֹר וְ לַ עֲשׂ֗וֹת אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֲדֹנֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.VUL: ut fácerent et custodírent univérsa mandáta Dómini Dei nostri ,
traditions.KJV: and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord ,

30.english_reference: and his judgments and his statutes ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מִשְׁפָּטָ֖י ו וְ חֻקָּֽי ו
traditions.VUL: et iudícia eius et cæremónias eius ,
traditions.KJV: and his judgments and his statutes ;

31.english_reference: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא נִתֵּ֥ן בְּנֹתֵ֖י נוּ לְ עַמֵּ֣י הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: et ut non darémus fílias nostras pópulo terræ ,
traditions.KJV: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land ,

31.english_reference: nor take their daughters for our sons

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּנֹ֣תֵי הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִקַּ֖ח לְ בָנֵֽי נוּ
traditions.VUL: et fílias eórum non acciperémus fíliis nostris .
traditions.KJV: nor take their daughters for our sons :

traditions.LXX: καὶ λαοὶ τῆς γῆς οἱ φέροντες τοὺς ἀγορασμοὺς καὶ πᾶσαν πρᾶσιν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου ἀποδόσθαι , οὐκ ἀγορῶμεν παρ᾽ αὐτῶν ἐν σαββάτῳ καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἁγίᾳ · καὶ ἀνήσομεν τὸ ἔτος τὸ ζ᾽ καὶ ἀπαίτησιν πάσης χειρός .

32.english_reference: And [ if ] the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell

traditions.WLC: וְ עַמֵּ֣י הָ אָ֡רֶץ הַֽ מְבִיאִים֩ אֶת הַ מַּקָּח֨וֹת וְ כָל שֶׁ֜בֶר בְּ י֤וֹם הַ שַּׁבָּת֙ לִ מְכּ֔וֹר
traditions.VUL: Pópuli quoque terræ , qui impórtant venália , et ómnia ad usum , per diem sábbati ut vendant ,
traditions.KJV: And [ if ] the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell , [ that ]

32.english_reference: [ that ] we would not buy it of them on the sabbath , or on the holy day

traditions.WLC: לֹא נִקַּ֥ח מֵ הֶ֛ם בַּ שַּׁבָּ֖ת וּ בְ י֣וֹם קֹ֑דֶשׁ
traditions.VUL: non accipiémus ab eis in sábbato et in die sanctificáto .
traditions.KJV: we would not buy it of them on the sabbath , or on the holy day :

32.english_reference: and [ that ] we would leave the seventh year , and the exaction of every debt

traditions.WLC: וְ נִטֹּ֛שׁ אֶת הַ שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ שְּׁבִיעִ֖ית וּ מַשָּׁ֥א כָל יָֽד
traditions.VUL: Et dimittémus annum séptimum , et exactiónem univérsæ manus .
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] we would leave the seventh year , and the exaction of every debt .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιήσομεν ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς ἐντολάς , δοῦναι ἐφ᾽ ἡμᾶς τρίτον τοῦ διδράχμου κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτὸν εἰς δουλείαν οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ,

33.english_reference: Also we made ordinances for us

traditions.KJV: Also we made ordinances for us ,

33.english_reference: to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God

traditions.WLC: לָ תֵ֥ת עָלֵ֛י נוּ שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַ שֶּׁ֖קֶל בַּ שָּׁנָ֑ה לַ עֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.VUL: ut demus tértiam partem sicli per annum ad opus domus Dei nostri ,
traditions.KJV: to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God ;

traditions.LXX: εἰς ἄρτους τοῦ προσώπου καὶ θυσίαν τοῦ ἐνδελεχισμοῦ , καὶ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα τοῦ ἐνδελεχισμοῦ τῶν σαββάτων , τῶν νουμηνιῶν , εἰς τὰς ἑορτὰς καὶ εἰς τὰ ἅγια , καὶ τὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ Ἰσραήλ , καὶ εἰς ἔργα οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν .

34.english_reference: For the shewbread , and for the continual meat offering , and for the continual burnt offering

traditions.WLC: לְ לֶ֣חֶם הַֽ מַּעֲרֶ֡כֶת וּ מִנְחַ֣ת הַ תָּמִ֣יד וּ לְ עוֹלַ֣ת הַ֠ תָּמִיד
traditions.VUL: ad panes propositiónis , et ad sacrifícium sempitérnum , et in holocáustum sempitérnum
traditions.KJV: For the shewbread , and for the continual meat offering , and for the continual burnt offering ,

34.english_reference: of the sabbaths , of the new moons , for the set feasts , and for the holy [ things ]

traditions.WLC: הַ שַּׁבָּת֨וֹת הֶ חֳדָשִׁ֜ים לַ מּוֹעֲדִ֗ים וְ לַ קֳּדָשִׁים֙
traditions.VUL: in sábbatis , in caléndis , in solemnitátibus , et in sanctificátis ,
traditions.KJV: of the sabbaths , of the new moons , for the set feasts , and for the holy [ things ] ,

34.english_reference: and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ֣ חַטָּא֔וֹת לְ כַפֵּ֖ר עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: et pro peccáto : ut exorétur pro Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel ,

34.english_reference: and [ for ] all the work of the house of our God

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֖ל מְלֶ֥אכֶת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.VUL: et in omnem usum domus Dei nostri .
traditions.KJV: and [ for ] all the work of the house of our God .

traditions.LXX: καὶ κλήρους ἐβάλομεν περὶ κλήρου ξυλοφορίας οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἐνέγκαι εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν , εἰς οἶκον πατριῶν ἡμῶν , εἰς καιροὺς χρόνων ἐνιαυτὸν κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτόν , ἐκκαῦσαι περὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν , ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βιβλίῳ ·

35.english_reference: And we cast the lots among the priests , the Levites , and the people , for the wood offering

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ גּוֹרָל֨וֹת הִפַּ֜לְנוּ עַל קֻרְבַּ֣ן הָ עֵצִ֗ים הַ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַ לְוִיִּם֮ וְ הָ עָם֒
traditions.VUL: Sortes ergo mísimus super oblatiónem lignórum inter sacerdótes , et Levítas , et pópulum ,
traditions.KJV: And we cast the lots among the priests , the Levites , and the people , for the wood offering ,

35.english_reference: to bring [ it ] into the house of our God , after the houses of our fathers , at times appointed year by year

traditions.WLC: לְ֠ הָבִיא לְ בֵ֨ית אֱלֹהֵ֧י נוּ לְ בֵית אֲבֹתֵ֛י נוּ לְ עִתִּ֥ים מְזֻמָּנִ֖ים שָׁנָ֣ה בְ שָׁנָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: ut inferréntur in domum Dei nostri per domos patrum nostrórum , per témpora , a tempóribus anni usque ad annum :
traditions.KJV: to bring [ it ] into the house of our God , after the houses of our fathers , at times appointed year by year ,

35.english_reference: to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God , as [ it is ] written in the law

traditions.WLC: לְ בַעֵ֗ר עַל מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ כַּ כָּת֖וּב בַּ תּוֹרָֽה
traditions.VUL: ut ardérent super altáre Dómini Dei nostri , sicut scriptum est in lege Móysi :
traditions.KJV: to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God , as [ it is ] written in the law :

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐνέγκαι τὰ πρωτογενήματα τῆς γῆς ἡμῶν καὶ πρωτογενήματα καρποῦ παντὸς ξύλου ἐνιαυτὸν κατ᾽ ἐνιαυτόν εἰς οἶκον ,

36.english_reference: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground , and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees , year by year , unto the house of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ הָבִ֞יא אֶת בִּכּוּרֵ֣י אַדְמָתֵ֗ נוּ וּ בִכּוּרֵ֛י כָּל פְּרִ֥י כָל עֵ֖ץ שָׁנָ֣ה בְ שָׁנָ֑ה לְ בֵ֖ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: et ut afferrémus primogénita terræ nostræ , et primitíva univérsi fructus omnis ligni , ab anno in annum , in domo Dómini .
traditions.KJV: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground , and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees , year by year , unto the house of the LORD :

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα υἱῶν ἡμῶν καὶ κτηνῶν ἡμῶν , ὡς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ , καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα βοῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ποιμνίων ἡμῶν ἐνέγκαι εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἡμῶν .

37.english_reference: Also the firstborn of our sons , and of our cattle , as [ it is ] written in the law

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּכֹר֤וֹת בָּנֵ֨י נוּ֙ וּ בְהֶמְתֵּ֔י נוּ כַּ כָּת֖וּב בַּ תּוֹרָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: et primitíva filiórum nostrórum et pécorum nostrórum , sicut scriptum est in lege ,
traditions.KJV: Also the firstborn of our sons , and of our cattle , as [ it is ] written in the law ,

37.english_reference: and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks , to bring to the house of our God

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת בְּכוֹרֵ֨י בְקָרֵ֜י נוּ וְ צֹאנֵ֗י נוּ לְ הָבִיא֙ לְ בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.VUL: et primitíva boum nostrórum , et óvium nostrárum , ut offerréntur in domo Dei nostri ,
traditions.KJV: and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks , to bring to the house of our God ,

37.english_reference: unto the priests that minister in the house of our God

traditions.WLC: לַ כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים בְּ בֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.VUL: sacerdótibus qui minístrant in domo Dei nostri :
traditions.KJV: unto the priests that minister in the house of our God :

traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν σίτων ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν παντὸς ξύλου , οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου , οἴσομεν τοῖς ἱερεῦσι , εἰς γαζοφυλάκιον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ , καὶ δεκάτην γῆς ἡμῶν τοῖς Λευείταις · καὶ αὐτοὶ οἱ Λευεῖται δεκατοῦντες ἐν πάσαις πόλεσιν δουλείας ἡμῶν ·

38.english_reference: And [ that ] we should bring the firstfruits of our dough , and our offerings , and the fruit of all manner of trees , of wine and of oil , unto the priests , to the chambers of the house of our God

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת רֵאשִׁ֣ית עֲרִיסֹתֵ֣י נוּ וּ֠ תְרוּמֹתֵי נוּ וּ פְרִ֨י כָל עֵ֜ץ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ יִצְהָ֗ר נָבִ֤יא לַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ אֶל לִשְׁכ֣וֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.VUL: et primítias cibórum nostrórum , et libáminum nostrórum , et poma omnis ligni , vindémiæ quoque et ólei , afferémus sacerdótibus ad gazophylácium Dei nostri ,
traditions.KJV: And [ that ] we should bring the firstfruits of our dough , and our offerings , and the fruit of all manner of trees , of wine and of oil , unto the priests , to the chambers of the house of our God ;

38.english_reference: and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites

traditions.WLC: וּ מַעְשַׂ֥ר אַדְמָתֵ֖ נוּ לַ לְוִיִּ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et décimam partem terræ nostræ Levítis .
traditions.KJV: and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites ,

38.english_reference: that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage

traditions.WLC: וְ הֵם֙ הַ לְוִיִּ֔ם הַֽ מְעַשְּׂרִ֔ים בְּ כֹ֖ל עָרֵ֥י עֲבֹדָתֵֽ נוּ
traditions.VUL: Ipsi Levítæ décimas accípient ex ómnibus civitátibus óperum nostrórum .
traditions.KJV: that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἱερεὺς Ἀαρὼν μετὰ τοῦ Λευείτου ἐν τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ Λευείτου , καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἀνοίσουσιν τὴν δεκάτην τῆς δεκάδος εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν εἰς τὰ γαζοφυλάκια εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ .

39.english_reference: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites , when the Levites take tithes

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָ֨ה הַ כֹּהֵ֧ן בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עִם הַ לְוִיִּ֖ם בַּ עְשֵׂ֣ר הַ לְוִיִּ֑ם
traditions.VUL: Erit autem sacérdos fílius Aaron cum Levítis in décimis Levitárum ,
traditions.KJV: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites , when the Levites take tithes :

39.english_reference: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God , to the chambers , into the treasure house

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֞ם יַעֲל֨וּ אֶת מַעֲשַׂ֤ר הַֽ מַּעֲשֵׂר֙ לְ בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ אֶל הַ לְּשָׁכ֖וֹת לְ בֵ֥ית הָ אוֹצָֽר
traditions.VUL: et Levítæ ófferent décimam partem décimæ suæ in domo Dei nostri ad gazophylácium in domum thesáuri .
traditions.KJV: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God , to the chambers , into the treasure house .

traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς τοὺς θησαυροὺς οἴσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ οἱ Λευεῖται ἀπαρχὰς τοῦ σίτου καὶ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου , καὶ ἐκεῖ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ λειτουργοὶ καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες · καὶ οὐκ ἐνκαταλείψομεν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν .

40.english_reference: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn , of the new wine , and the oil , unto the chambers

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֶל הַ֠ לְּשָׁכוֹת יָבִ֨יאוּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ בְנֵ֣י הַ לֵּוִ֗י אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַ דָּגָן֮ הַ תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ הַ יִּצְהָר֒
traditions.VUL: Ad gazophylácium enim deportábunt fílii Israel , et fílii Levi , primítias fruménti , vini , et ólei :
traditions.KJV: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn , of the new wine , and the oil , unto the chambers ,

40.english_reference: where [ are ] the vessels of the sanctuary , and the priests that minister , and the porters , and the singers

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁם֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַ מִּקְדָּ֔שׁ וְ הַ כֹּהֲנִים֙ הַ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים וְ הַ שּׁוֹעֲרִ֖ים וְ הַ מְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: et ibi erunt vasa sanctificáta , et sacerdótes , et cantóres , et ianitóres , et minístri ,
traditions.KJV: where [ are ] the vessels of the sanctuary , and the priests that minister , and the porters , and the singers :

40.english_reference: and we will not forsake the house of our God

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֥א נַעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת בֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.VUL: et non dimittémus domum Dei nostri .
traditions.KJV: and we will not forsake the house of our God .
